title: [$175] Show the Reimbursable toggle on company card expenses when the card feed is set to Do Not Force
body:
Coming from [here](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/C049HHMV9SM/p1790883631538969), we want to show the Reimbursable toggle on company card expenses when the card feed allows the value to change, matching cash expenses and company card expenses in Expensify Classic. ### Details - Today, New Expensify hides the `Reimbursable` toggle on every company card expense in the expense detail view and in bulk edit. Expensify Classic shows the toggle when the card feed is set to either `Do Not Force` option, but customers on those settings can't change reimbursability on card expenses in New Expensify. - The feed's Reimbursable setting doesn't exist in New Expensify yet. This issue doesn't need it: the toggle uses the `forceReimbursable` value stamped on each card expense at import. - Adding the feed setting to New Expensify is tracked separately: https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/103342 - **Forced value:** We will use the `forceReimbursable` value stamped on each card expense at import to decide whether the toggle appears. Changing the feed setting only affects expenses imported afterward, matching Classic. * **Force No** (`force_no`, default): Toggle hidden. * **Force Yes** (`force_yes`): Toggle hidden. * **Do Not Force (Defaults to Reimbursable)** (`default_yes`): Toggle shown and editable. * **Do Not Force (Defaults to Non-Reimbursable)** (`default_no`, or legacy `none`): Toggle shown and editable. - For new card transactions, the feed setting sets the starting value. Do Not Force (Defaults to Reimbursable) starts as reimbursable, and Do Not Force (Defaults to Non-Reimbursable) starts as non-reimbursable. - The Do Not Force settings don't restrict edits after an expense is imported, so users can change the value on each expense. The toggle shows each expense's current value. - The toggle uses the existing `Reimbursable` label, matching cash expenses in NewDot today. - **Bulk edit expense:** We will show the Reimbursable row when none of the selected expenses has a forced value stamped on it. Selections that mix cash and non-forced card expenses show the row. If any selected expense is forced to reimbursable/non-reimbursable, the row is hidden, matching how New Expensify already handles forced cash expenses. - This change does not apply Expensify Card transactions, which can never be reimbursable. ### Existing reimbursable toggle on cash expenses ### Existing reimbursable feed setting in Expensify Classic that controls whether we will show this reimbursable toggle on card expenses in New Expensify

Company card expenses never get the Reimbursable toggle in the expense view or the bulk edit page, even when the card feed is on one of the two Do Not Force settings and Classic lets the value change. The toggle has to follow the force setting the feed stamps on each card expense at import.
